newsitem.title: USA: NRC, ConEd seen meeting next week on NY nuke.
newsitem.headline: NRC, ConEd seen meeting next week on NY nuke.

text.p: The Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) and Consolidated Edison Co of New York Inc (ConEd) are expected to meet next week over the current shutdown of the Indian Point 2 nuclear generating unit.
"We're looking at late next week at the earliest," an NRC spokesman said Thursday, when asked when the meeting would likely take place.

The 975 megawatt (MW) unit at the Indian Point facility along the Hudson River north of New York City was shut January 27 due to a problem tied to a cleaning material found in the unit's feedwater and condensate systems.
ConEd previously said it would discuss with the NRC findings related to the outage before restarting Indian Point 2.
The company today said the unit would resume production over the next couple of weeks.
In its daily status report, the NRC provided a tentative February 19 startup date for Indian Point 2.
